statutes.title: Philippine Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Act of 2010

key_sections.title: Barangay Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Plan (BDRRMP)
key_sections.summary: Mandates the formulation and implementation of a comprehensive Barangay Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Plan (BDRRMP) integrated into the Barangay Development Plan.

key_sections.title: Local Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Fund (LDRRMF)
key_sections.summary: Mandates not less than five percent (5%) of estimated revenue from regular sources to support disaster risk management activities, with 30% allocated for Quick Response Fund (QRF).

key_sections.title: Early Warning Systems and Emergency Operations
key_sections.summary: Mandates the establishment of an operating facility to be known as the Barangay Emergency Operations Center (EOC) with functional early warning and hotline capabilities.

key_sections.title: Basic Services and Facilities
key_sections.summary: Mandates LGUs and barangays to deliver basic services including health, social welfare, infrastructure, solid waste disposal, and disaster response.

key_sections.title: Local Development Fund
key_sections.summary: Mandates every LGU to appropriate in its annual budget no less than twenty percent (20%) of its annual Internal Revenue Allotment for development projects (AIP/CDP).

key_sections.title: Powers and Duties of the Punong Barangay
key_sections.summary: Empowers the Punong Barangay to enforce laws, maintain public order, administer barangay affairs, and coordinate basic service delivery with city departments.

statutes.title: Ecological Solid Waste Management Act of 2000

key_sections.title: Role of LGUs in Solid Waste Management
key_sections.summary: Designates segregation and collection of biodegradable, compostable and reusable wastes to the barangay level, while collection of non-recyclable materials is city responsibility.

key_sections.title: Establishment of Materials Recovery Facility (MRF)
key_sections.summary: Mandates the establishment of an MRF in every barangay or cluster of barangays for ecological processing of solid waste.

key_sections.title: Local Health Systems and Primary Care Networks
key_sections.summary: Directs provinces and highly urbanized cities to integrate health systems into Province-Wide and City-Wide Health Systems, prioritizing primary care and disease surveillance.

key_sections.title: Health Human Resources & Community Health Workers
key_sections.summary: Ensures adequate deployment of Barangay Health Workers (BHWs) and sanitary inspectors to monitor WASH compliance and maternal-child health.

statutes.title: National Building Code of the Philippines

key_sections.title: Dangerous and Ruinous Buildings and Structures
key_sections.summary: Empowers the City Engineer/Building Official to inspect, declare, and order repair or condemnation of structures posing structural, fire, or seismic hazards.

key_sections.title: Building Permits and Structural Integrity Standards
key_sections.summary: Mandates adherence to minimum structural design standards for walls, roofs, and foundations to withstand extreme weather events.

key_sections.title: Selection of Qualified Household Beneficiaries
key_sections.summary: Establishes standardized targeting systems utilizing CBMS poverty and vulnerability criteria to identify eligible households for education and health cash grants.

key_sections.title: Convergence of Social Welfare Programs
key_sections.summary: Directs national agencies and LGUs to coordinate social assistance, livelihood (AICS/SLP), and skills training to ensure long-term self-sufficiency.

key_sections.title: Criteria for Lawful Processing of Personal Information
key_sections.summary: Requires strict safeguards, anonymization, and aggregation when processing statistical data for public governance to prevent identification of individual households.

key_sections.title: Security of Personal Information
key_sections.summary: Mandates organizational, physical, and technical measures to protect sensitive data, enforcing row-level access control across municipal departments.
